$comment: Source rows that no research pass recorded, added because a corpus source reads them. `buildSourceRegister` reads each row after the research CSV's rows, in the CSV's own columns, so its id and license scope come from the same derivation. Every row here reads `CORPUS INPUT, TERMS UNREAD`, which derives an `unchecked` decision: the row exists so that the gap shows in the register rather than hiding as an absence. A decision is recorded in `license-decisions.json` like any other. See `corpus-source-inputs.json` for which corpus source reads each one.

The places theme is read for venue names by the venue and sub-venue recipes, through place-names/names.parquet and poi.db. One row holds both because the register scopes a decision to one publisher in one jurisdiction, and the two themes carry different terms, so a decision records each theme's terms separately.

rows.source: Federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings (GWR) building addresses, through OpenAddresses ch/countrywide
rows.authority_basis: The BFS keeps the GWR under the VGWR (SR 431.841) and publishes its access level A data, which include streets and building addresses
rows.access: OpenAddresses ch/countrywide as run in 2021, whose source at openaddresses/openaddresses e880e070c5f1 downloaded https://data.geo.admin.ch/ch.bfs.gebaeude_wohnungs_register/CSV/CH/CH.zip
rows.notes: The on-disk openaddresses/extracted/ch/countrywide.csv is dated 2021-10-17. OpenAddresses switched ch/countrywide to swisstopo's official building address directory only on 2024-11-22 (520f9ebf45a6), so the file the rendered-ch and fragment-assay recipes read is this BFS publication rather than ch-property-building-1.

rows.authority_basis: The IDE, the national spatial data infrastructure under Presidencia de la República, publishes the national geographic address points
rows.access: One CSV per department on catalogodatos.gub.uy, CKAN dataset `ide-direcciones-geograficas-del-uruguay` in the organization `ide`
rows.notes: Read by the ide-uy adapter. 1,059,247 address points across 19 department files retrieved 2026-10-17, each with postcode, street, door number and census locality.
